_readme: DON G FX news calendar — high-impact windows where the FX brain refuses new orders.
Copy this file to %APPDATA%\tf\data\news-calendar.json and keep it current.
time: ISO-8601 UTC instant of the release. impact: high = blocks (default), medium/low = ignored.
The brain refuses orders from (time - NewsBlackoutMinutes) to (time + NewsBlackoutMinutes).
A missing or malformed file means no known events — it never blocks trading by itself.
